info.description: Directory microservice handling Faculties, Departments, Service Units, User Affiliations and Service Responsibilities. Versioned API under /api/v1.
info.title: University Directory Service

get.description: Retrieve a list of organizational affiliations with optional filters and pagination.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search in user id and department/faculty code and name
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Case-insensitive search in user id and department/faculty code and name
schema.title: Q

post.description: Create an organizational affiliation linking a user to a department and faculty. The user must exist and be ACTIVE in the Identity Service.

get.description: Retrieve the current organizational affiliation for a specific user.

delete.description: Permanently delete a user organizational affiliation record.

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific affiliation by its unique identifier.

put.description: Update or transfer a user affiliation to another department/faculty. The affiliated user must still be ACTIVE in the Identity Service.

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific department by its identifier or department code.
get.summary: Get Department by ID or Code

patch.description: Partially update details of an existing department.

put.description: Update details (name, code, faculty_id) of an existing department.

parameters.name: q

schema.title: Q

post.description: Assign a responsibility to a user for a service unit, department and/or faculty. Referenced units must exist; an ACTIVE responsibility requires the user to be ACTIVE in the Identity Service and must not duplicate another ACTIVE one for the same scope.

delete.description: Permanently delete a service responsibility record.

put.description: Update the title, status or organizational scope of a responsibility. Deactivating does not require the user to be active in the Identity Service.
